notes: The finish is the pad textured `tony/brushes/endboost` (470x470 at [7136 1744 3984]): the trigger_multiple on it (filter cp_deny) renames the player cp_cp, fires the env_fades `fade`/`fade2` and after 5 s renames them cp_tele; a trigger_push filtered on cp_cp throws them up, and the trigger_teleport around it filtered on cp_teleport (1728x1728x3072) sends them to the destination named `end`, a separate room at [-1736 -1488 352]. That teleport is the finish line here rather than the pad, because this importer does not read filters and the column would otherwise be a pit enclosing the pad; entering it is entering the finish room. It is the far end of the route: section returns run t_dest_1..t_dest_38 and t_dest_38's section is the one beside it. The route is three parts joined by two door-sized teleports, `part2` (96x96, end of t_dest_18's part) and `part3` (64x64, end of t_dest_30's), which are the stages. The start: players spawn in a room at [-7672 4062] whose floor teleports to `spawn`, the intro camera; `start_relay` parks them for 14 s and then drops them at [-5760 3744 2440] into the pool of the start room below, whose exit (a trigger_multiple at y 4992..5248 that switches on the course fog) leads into section 1 and the t_dest_1 pit. The start line is that room.

conditional_teleports.note: the map's anti-standing trap: a trigger_multiple on each block sets the player's name to the one this filter passes after a delay and resets it after another, so the teleport only fires on a player who stood on a block too long. This game does not run the map's outputs, so imported unconditionally it fired on every landing. Dropped; standing still is allowed here and costs the player time instead

zones.note: the start room the intro drops you into (pool and floor at z 0), up to the fog trigger at its exit
on the start room's floor. Not `spawn`: that is the intro camera 2400 units up, and the info_player_* entities are in the room that teleports you to it
part 2: the drop column under `part2`, where the 96x96 door at the end of part 1 lands you, down to the platform t_dest_19 stands on
part 3: the 336x336 trigger_multiple around `part3` (it resets the fog on arrival), reached only through the 64x64 door at the end of part 2

the 1728x1728 column around the endboost pad that sends a finished player to the `end` room. The other teleport aimed at `end` is the 3072-wide floor of the end room itself, which the width limit excludes
